title: Interpretation 14-23 (City of Bothell): restaurant tenant space over 3,000 sf and vestibule requirement in a five-story mixed-use building (WSEC Commercial C402.4.7)
jurisdiction: Washington State, requested by City of Bothell (comparative test only; not Alberta)
code_edition: 2012 Washington State Energy Code, Commercial, Section C402.4.7, as cited

facts.text: Document type: State Building Code Council interpretation no. 14-23, one page; requester City of Bothell.
Project as described: a tenant space for a proposed restaurant totals more than 3,000 sf; the eating area is 2,300 sf and the remainder is separated by partitions.

Building as described: five stories; ground-floor footprint 71,000 sf with a parking garage, residential units, lobby and commercial tenant spaces along the perimeter; the upper four floors are residential.
The commercial tenant space is fully enclosed with its own entrance; there are multiple ground-floor entrances into the various spaces.
